sequence_description: Direct token endpoint: mint a custom JWT with a forged issuer (trust-anchor substitution) and attempt to use it for JWT-based login. Expect rejection; acceptance indicates issuer/JWKS trust confusion.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_jwt_forged_issuer_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_jwt_forged_issuer_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT login accepted a token with forged issuer/trust anchor; authenticity checks not bound to intended verification policy.

sequence_description: OIDC SSO: attempt to authenticate via enterprise OIDC connector where IdP omits nonce (freshness binding). Then repeat the same login to probe replay acceptance of a nonce-less id_token.
description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.

sequence_description: OIDC SSO freshness: attempt enterprise OIDC login where IdP omits nonce (should be rejected). Then perform a normal password login as a second identity to ensure the system is functional and to detect any unintended session creation from the rejected SSO attempt.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_oidc_nonce_1_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_oidc_nonce_1_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: RP accepted an enterprise OIDC SSO login even though the IdP omitted nonce; this enables callback replay across sessions.

sequence_description: Enterprise OIDC SSO: mock IdP omits nonce in id_token. RP must reject when nonce was sent. Also verify no session was created by attempting /oidc/me (should be unauthorized). Includes a second identity password login as control.
description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.

description:
Assertion FAILED: user_oidc_nonce_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_oidc_nonce_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: RP accepted an enterprise OIDC SSO login where id_token nonce was missing despite nonce being required — nonce bypass enables replay.

sequence_description: Enterprise OIDC SSO: mock IdP omits nonce in id_token. RP must reject when nonce was sent. Also verify no session was created by attempting /oidc/me (should be unauthorized). Includes a second identity password login as control.
description:

Evaluation: user_oidc_nonce_attack_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After rejected nonce-less OIDC SSO attempt, /oidc/me was still accessible (session created unexpectedly).

sequence_description: I4 attack: two distinct SAML principals (different NameID/sub) but same email attempt to collapse into one downstream identity; verify whether mapping improperly merges principals.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_p1_entity_id != user_saml_p2_entity_id
Evaluation: user_saml_p1_entity_id='hzk9lqvces9x' != 'hzk9lqvces9x' → False
Implication: Two security-distinct SAML principals (different sub/NameID) collapsed into the same downstream identity (principal binding failure)

sequence_description: Cross-protocol merge attempt: create a local password user, then OIDC SSO login with same email (email_verified=true) but different upstream sub; verify they do not collapse into the same downstream identity.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_oidc_crossproto_entity_id != user_A_entity_id
Evaluation: user_oidc_crossproto_entity_id='rdhbrawin89h' != 'rdhbrawin89h' → False
Implication: OIDC SSO principal collapsed into the local password user's identity (cross-protocol identity merge)

sequence_description: Forge a SAML assertion with Conditions removed and attempt login; SP should reject because time/audience restrictions are missing (prevents overbroad authorization).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_i5_saml_cond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_i5_saml_cond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted a SAML assertion without Conditions; missing audience/time constraints can overgrant authorization beyond upstream intent.
